name: Rapidgator
description: Resolves Rapidgator links with a premium account, or without one via the free flow.

account.secret_hint: Enter your account e-mail as username and your password as secret.

codes.rapidgator.free_link_host_mismatch: Rapidgator returned a download link on an unexpected host: {host}

codes.rapidgator.ip_denied: Rapidgator denied the request from this IP address
codes.rapidgator.limit_reached: Rapidgator traffic or storage limit was reached
